This contribution provides a summary for maintenance issues on SRS Enhancements for Rel-18 Work Item on “MIMO Evolution for Downlink and Uplink” (NR_MIMO_evo_DL_UL). In this meeting, 4 contributions [1-4] were submitted with discussions and proposals related to Rel-18 MIMO SRS. The issues related to TDMed / non-TDMed SRS and associated PUSCH, such as the feature group design, capabilities, etc., may be handled under the agenda item for 8Tx SRI/TPMI or under this item, depending on the views of the companies.
